name: MEISEI INDUSTRIAL Co.,Ltd.
summary: MEISEI INDUSTRIAL Co.,Ltd. operates as a construction works company in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Construction Work Business and Boiler Business. It offers hot and cold insulation systems, including the Keical-Ace Super-Silica, which is used in various fields as a primary hot insulation material; the Keical-Ace Win for rust prevention of heat-insulated objects; and the Recycal, developed for energy saving and resource-recycling.
